extension.name: Arabic-vs-multilingual encoder probe on a frozen Gulf slice
extension.evidence: notebooks/05_arabic_nlp.ipynb — identical conditions (same seed, same 40 optimizer steps, same frozen Gulf test): distilbert-base-multilingual-cased scored gulf_test_macro_f1 0.0 against CAMeL-Lab/bert-base-arabic-camelbert-da at 0.6667. Corroborated by notebooks/07 slice analysis (variant=Gulf 0.658 vs variant=MSA 0.837). Decision recorded in DECISIONS.md#decision-d-003: REJECT_FOR_NOW — the direction is credible but the frozen Gulf test is 4 rows with no confidence interval, and an Arabic-only encoder would trade a measured Arabic gain for an unmeasured English loss in a bilingual system. Adoption is gated on a frozen-data comparison with intervals on both language slices.
